summary: A session that starts normally on an account with no market data: every request is accepted and nothing comes back, not even an error.

provenance.observed: 2026-11-08 (the market-data field notes of that day): a paper account without shared market data answered every request with no figures and no error at all.
provenance.why: The account this gateway is logged in to is entitled now, so the shape cannot be reproduced on it, and that session's bytes were not kept.
provenance.built: normal-with-greeks' handshake, farm notices included (recorded 2026-11-09), and its lookup with no reply. Whether that session's lookups answered while its market data did not was not noted; this takes 'every request accepted, nothing back' literally, as ADR 0021 states it.
